description: Answer the common question "what is on in this city" over a named window, using fixed definitions in the city's local time: this_weekend means Friday to Sunday; if today is Saturday or Sunday it means the current weekend, otherwise the coming one. this_week means today through the coming Sunday. next_7_days means today through today plus 6 days. today means today only. Results are sorted by start date and include the event page, the verification date and, where the event page carries one, a booking link. Dates marked expected are expected dates, not yet confirmed by the organiser. This server is read-only: it takes no bookings, and prices and availability are confirmed on the merchant's site.

category.description: Optional category; one of the city's own category values, listed by list_cities.

city.description: City slug or name from list_cities, for example "hong-kong".

limit.description: Maximum events to return. Default 10, maximum 25.

name: whats_on
title: What is on in a city: today, this weekend, this week or the next 7 days
